meaning: rice straw; the dried stalks left after rice is harvested

example.romanization: A-kûng yung vo̍ kón lòi pa̍k coi.
example.english: Grandfather uses rice straw to tie up vegetables.

note: Rice straw was once everywhere in Hakka farming villages, used for roofing, fuel, tying things and even as bedding. Stacks of it, called 禾稈堆, were a familiar sight in the fields after harvest.
